INSERT INTO client_ratings (
                delivery_id,
                client_id,
                courier_id,
                score_small,
                tags,
                comment
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
            ON CONFLICT (delivery_id)
            DO UPDATE SET
                score_small = EXCLUDED.score_small,
                tags = EXCLUDED.tags,
                comment = EXCLUDED.comment,
                created_at = NOW()
            RETURNING
                id,
                delivery_id,
                client_id,
                courier_id,
                score_small,
                tags,
                comment,
                created_at
